identities.acceptance_scope: Prior run acceptance binds the unchanged client. New launcher validated offline; no new gameplay acceptance claimed.

changes: Explicit project-download policy accepts bounded valid Zone.Identifier metadata without deleting it; strict default policy and required Steam signatures remain unchanged.
One native launcher and canonical full ZIP for both ordinary use and optional gameplay/system diagnostics.
Always-on bounded, flushed startup journal before SDL and UI initialization; independent from gameplay/system checkboxes.
Retain sanitized fatal SDL/OpenGL client error output instead of discarding everything except status markers.
Native Windows errors at failing APIs and client exit codes in decimal/hex with appropriate hints.
Native startup ZIP export and folder buttons; no PowerShell or installed archiver required.
Delay-load SDL and load exact adjacent DLL with restricted search so missing SDL produces startup evidence.
Resolve newer DPI APIs dynamically with fallback rather than hard imports.
Retire the old script GUI from packaging; previous deliveries remain recoverable under dist/archive.
